title: Raw etale chart: right scalar factorization and composite counit equation
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes are separated of finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On either the ordinary etale or pro-etale site let $\mathcal C_{T,R}=D^b_{ctf}(T,R)$ mean the full category of constant-$R$ module complexes with bounded constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude: tensor with any degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology in one fixed finite interval [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude, det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer]. Write $T_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The finite Tate line is $R_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}R_T$ on the etale site and its comparison inverse image on the pro-etale site; $(d)$ denotes tensor with its $d$th tensor power [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist].
Work on the ordinary etale site. Let $d\geq0$, $V=\mathbf A^d_Y$, $p_d:V\to Y$ and $e:U\to V$ be separated etale of finite type. Put $E_R=De_{\Sigma!,R}$, $h_R=e_R^*$, $P_R=Rp_{d!,R}$ and $G_R=p_{d,R}^*(-)(d)[2d]$ for $R=A,B$. Use the sum adjunction $E_R\dashv h_R$ with counit $v_R$ and the ordered affine-space adjunction $P_R\dashv G_R$ with counit $u_R$ [lem-sp-etale-sum-counit-scalar, lem-sp-affine-counit-scalar]. The composite adjunction $P_RE_R\dashv h_RG_R$ has counit
$$w_{R,K}=u_{R,K}\circ P_R(v_{R,G_RK}).$$
Use the specified affine compact-support coefficient comparison $\beta_d:T_YP_A\to P_BT_V$, summandwise comparison $\sigma_e:T_VE_A\to E_BT_U$, and canonical right comparisons $a_d:T_VG_A\to G_BT_Y$, $a_e:T_Uh_A\to h_BT_V$ from those nodes. Define
$$s_M=P_B(\sigma_e(M))\circ\beta_d(E_AM),\qquad
 a_K:T_Uh_AG_AK\xrightarrow{\sim}h_BG_BT_YK$$
where $a_K$ is the canonical derived tensor/pullback, Tate and shift identification of the explicit composite right functor [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Then, on these finite-Tor categories, the right comparison factors as
$$a_K=h_B(a_{d,K})\circ a_e(G_AK),$$
and the raw composite counit satisfies
$$w_{B,T_YK}\circ P_BE_B(a_K)\circ s_{h_AG_AK}=T_Y(w_{A,K})$$
for every $K\in\mathcal C_{Y,A}$. All intermediate objects and the scalar extensions in this formula lie in the indicated bounded constructible finite-Tor categories [lem-sp-etale-ctf-chart-domain]. The assertions use the given order of affine integrations and the actual sum counit, for arbitrary $A\to B$, with no flatness or finite projective-dimension assumption. No compact-support left comparison for $p_de$ is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Apply etaleCtfChartDomain separately for A and B to the tower projection and to e. The schemes in the tower carry their composite structure maps to Spec k and are separated of finite type. Finite type over the field gives Noetherianity. The named affineTraceRight_normalForm identifies the ordered right functor with derived pullback, right tensor by the positive finite Tate power, and shift by 2d. Transport the chart-domain assertion across the exact/left-derived pullback isomorphism and derived tensor symmetry. The zeroth-twist, zero-shift chart operation identifies with exact pullback by the tensor unitor. For sum extension, choose a compactification over k and transport compact-support preservation across EtaleCompactSupportNormalization.comparison. Apply etaleCtfChartScalarDomain at Y, the tower, and U. This proves every displayed domain implication, including dimension zero and the zero coefficient ring.

proof.text: Unfold rawChartScalarIso, reductionEtaleChartScalarIso, and properOpenCoefficientPullbackIso. By definition the derived chart comparison is scalarPullbackIso inverse at G_A K followed by derived pullback of reductionEtaleAffineScalarIso. Naturality of leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory for B moves that affine scalar arrow through the final presentation isomorphism. The resulting composite is exactly properOpenCoefficientPullbackIso inverse at G_A K followed by exact pullback of the affine scalar arrow. This is rawChartScalarIso_factor, proved for every derived input without a finite-Tor hypothesis. No new Tate, monoidal-comparison, or shift coherence calculation is required because the canonical chart scalar comparison is already defined as this ordered composite.

proof.text:
Fix $K$ and abbreviate $J=G_AK$, $J'=G_BT_YK$, $t=a_{d,K}:T_VJ\to J'$. By naturality of the actual etale counit at $t$,
$$v_{B,J'}\circ E_Bh_B(t)=t\circ v_{B,T_VJ}.$$
Substitute the factorization of Step 2 and $s_{h_AJ}=P_B(\sigma_e(h_AJ))\circ\beta_d(E_Ah_AJ)$ into the required left side, and use functoriality of $P_B,E_B$. The result is
$$u_{B,T_YK}\circ P_B(t)\circ P_B\bigl(v_{B,T_VJ}\circ E_B(a_e(J))\circ\sigma_e(h_AJ)\bigr)\circ\beta_d(E_Ah_AJ).$$
Apply the precise sum-counit equation of [lem-sp-etale-sum-counit-scalar] at the permitted input $J$. This expression becomes
$$u_{B,T_YK}\circ P_B(t)\circ P_BT_V(v_{A,J})\circ\beta_d(E_Ah_AJ).$$
This is substitution and naturality of the given natural transformations, without replacing the sum counit by a transported compact-support counit.

source.place: Charts, summation over etale fibres commutes with coefficients; explicit naturality calculation

proof.text: Apply the published etaleProEtaleCoefficientCompatibility_naturality at the sum counit v_A(J), using the domain conclusions of Step 1 for its source and target. It moves scalar extension of P_A(v_A(J)) across the specified affine coefficient arrow. Reassociate and apply affine_counit_scalar at K. Its existential Noetherianity and invertibility proofs agree with the chosen ones by proof irrelevance. Functoriality of scalarExtension identifies the result with its map of P_A(v_A(J)) followed by the affine counit. Together with Step 3, this is exactly the expanded rawChartCounit equation. The zero-coordinate case uses the same identities, with the published identity tower.
